name: А у тебя шнурок развязался!
alt: Суровый рыцарь растерялся из-за огромного развязанного шнурка.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms and strong readable silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one clear visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs or malformed objects. Subject: One stocky adult fantasy knight in chunky steel armor and a crimson cape looks down in horror at ONE comically oversized brown lace-up boot with its long shoelace completely untied and looping loosely on the floor. Exactly two arms and two legs; one gauntlet points at the lace, other rests on hip. Helmet visor raised revealing puzzled eyebrows and mustache. Full figure, simple clear anatomy, no other figures.
